job.title: INC032 : Apprentice, Customer Solution
job.sourceDescription:
• The Apprentice will support pricing and quotation activities under supervision, ensuring timely and accurate customer proposals.

PRINCIPLE DUTIES, AND RESPONSIBILITIES   

  • Assist in preparing customer quotes and pricing proposals for Air and Ocean services.
  • Support compilation and coordination of RFQs in line with internal pricing guidelines.
  • Help maintain and update pricing data, including rates and surcharges.
  • Assist with basic reporting and data compilation for pricing and revenue tracking.
  • Support documentation of pricing processes and system requirements.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, and Revenue teams to share pricing information and resolve basic queries.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS FOR SUCCESSFUL PERFORMANCE

Academic:

  • General Graduate or Diploma holder in Logistics Management is preferable

Experience & knowledge:

  • Good command of written and spoken English, local language

Attribute:

  • Hardworking, able to work independently
  • Detail-oriented
  • Good communication skills

The Company

FedEx Logistics provides e-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.

The Philosophy

People–Service–Profit (P-S-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well-being and value their contributions to the company.

The Culture

We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.

The Mission

We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.

We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

Graduate Apprentice Trainee – CAD/Creo (NATS) Location: Volvo Group India Program: National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) About Volvo Group At Volvo Group, we drive prosperity through transport and infrastructure solutions, shaping the future of sustainable mobility. As a global leader in the transportation industry, we are committed to developing innovative and sustainable engineering solutions. Through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS), we offer fresh engineering graduates an opportunity to gain practical industry experience, develop technical competencies and work alongside experienced professionals on real-world engineering projects. Role Overview As Graduate Apprentice, you will support engineering design and development activities, gaining hands-on experience in Computer-Aided Design (CAD), 3D modelling, engineering drawings and product development processes. You will work with experienced engineering teams and learn to apply industry standards and engineering practices. Eligibility Criteria Education: B.E. / B. Tech in Mechanical Engineering or Automobile Engineering. Year of Graduation: 2024, 2025 or 2026. Program Eligibility: Candidates must meet the eligibility requirements prescribed under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS). Experience: Fresh graduates; prior industry experience is not mandatory. Academic Performance: Minimum 65% aggregate throughout academics (10th, 12th / Diploma and Graduation). Key Skills & Technical Competencies Strong fundamentals in Mechanical / Automobile Engineering. Basic knowledge of CAD software such as Creo, CATIA or SolidWorks. Understanding of 2D engineering drawings, 3D modelling and design concepts. Basic knowledge of engineering drawing standards, GD&T and manufacturing processes. Proficiency in MS Office applications, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint. Knowledge of Power BI, data analytics or programming will be an added advantage. Good analytical, problem-solving and learning abilities. Effective communication, collaboration and teamwork skills. Program Duration As per the applicable National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) guidelines. What You Will Gain Hands-on exposure to real-world automotive engineering and CAD design activities. Opportunity to work with experienced engineering professionals. Practical understanding of product development and engineering processes. Development of technical, analytical and professional competencies. Exposure to Volvo Group's engineering standards and global working practices.

job.title: Traffic Engineer (fresher upto 3 yrs exp)
job.sourceDescription:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

Arcadis IBI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Traffic / Transportation Engineer specialized in Traffic Due Diligence Studies for Highway Assets at its Hyderabad office Location. The ideal candidate should possess solid background in traffic engineering and data analytics, with a  experience of 0-3 years. He or She should have a technical acumen and can effectively tailor traffic and transportation engineering solutions to support the team objectives. Your responsibilities will encompass conducting comprehensive traffic studies, leveraging data analytics tools, and producing insightful reports. Your strong communication and presentation skills will be instrumental in conveying findings effectively.

Responsibilities: 

1. Conduct Traffic Due Diligence Studies: Conduct comprehensive traffic engineering assessments and due diligence studies for highway assets including liaison with Government authorities at Field. 

2. Data collection and collation: Oversee the systematic gathering of comprehensive traffic data, including vehicle counts, classifications, origin-destination, axle load and other traffic surveys. Ensure the accurate compilation and organization of collected data from Field and Office, validating its integrity for reliable analysis, and forecasting in the due diligence process. 

3. Data Analytics: Utilize various data analytics tools and techniques to extract, analyze, and interpret traffic-related data, contributing to evidence-based decision-making processes and efficient reporting. 

4. Communication and Presentation: Effectively communicate technical findings, methodologies, and recommendations to internal teams, clients, and stakeholders through clear and concise presentations, both written and oral. 

5. Report Writing: Prepare detailed and well-structured technical reports documenting the outcomes of due diligence studies, providing actionable insights and recommendations to address any identified traffic-related issues with a high degree of clarity, accuracy, and attention to detail. 

6. Collaborative Team Player: Collaborate with cross-functional teams including civil engineers, transportation planners, and urban designers / planners contributing to a holistic approach in project evaluations. 

7. Quality Assurance: Implement quality assurance processes to ensure accuracy, reliability, and consistency in all traffic engineering assessments and due diligence studies. 

8. Continuous Learning: Stay abreast of the latest advancements and trends in traffic engineering, data analytics, and related fields, and apply this knowledge to enhance the effectiveness of due diligence studies. 

 

Qualifications: 

1. Educational Background: A post-graduate degree in Civil Engineering, Transportation Engineering or Planning or a closely related field, with a strong focus on traffic engineering and transportation planning. 

2. Experience: Around 0 to 3 years of experience in traffic engineering, with a specific emphasis on conducting due diligence studies for highway assets. 

3. Data Analytics Skills: Highly proficient in using data analytics tools such as MS Excel, Python, or other relevant software to analyze and interpret traffic data. 

4. Professional Certifications: Any relevant certifications and transport modelling expertise in traffic engineering and / or data analytics will be an advantage. 

5. Experience in Investment Grade Traffic due diligence studies is Highly preferrable. 

 

Why Arcadis?

We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.

You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.

Together, we can create a lasting legacy.

Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.

Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

job.title: Data Science / AI ML Engineer
job.sourceDescription:
About the Role: We are hiring Data Science / AI & ML Engineers (Freshers) to work on compiler frameworks, transformer-based infrastructures, and end-to-end AI pipelines. You will collaborate with research teams to translate mathematical models into optimized execution graphs, implement custom kernels and low-level performance optimizations, and contribute to the development of deep learning frameworks and execution runtimes powering large-scale model training.
Education: Any Graduate
Key Responsibilities: Design and develop compiler frameworks that optimize AI model execution at the kernel, graph, and operator levels; Architect scalable transformer-based infrastructures for distributed multi-node training and efficient inference; Build end-to-end AI pipelines including graph optimizations, memory scheduling, and compute distribution; Collaborate with research teams to translate mathematical models into optimized execution graphs and intermediate representations (IRs); Implement custom kernels, quantization strategies, and low-level performance optimizations in C/C++ and CUDA; Analyze and tune runtime performance bottlenecks focusing on parallelization, vectorization, and memory management; Develop domain-specific compiler passes for tensor operations, automatic differentiation, and operator fusion; Conduct systematic experiments to explore scaling laws, precision formats, and architectural optimizations for improved computational efficiency; Contribute to the development and optimization of deep learning frameworks and execution runtimes, focusing on tensor computation graphs, distributed training pipelines, and execution scheduling; Work on data and training infrastructure including dataset preparation pipelines, tokenization strategies, preprocessing workflows, and evaluation systems for large-scale model training; Participate in model efficiency research including quantization techniques, sparsity methods, precision formats, and inference optimization for large-scale neural networks
Requirements: Strong proficiency in C, C++ or Java, with good command over pointers, memory management, performance optimization, and systems-level programming; Solid foundation in Mathematics - calculus, probability, statistics, and linear algebra; Strong logical reasoning, problem-solving ability, high intelligence (IQ), and an analytical mindset; Ability to operate effectively in a research-driven, high-intensity environment with cross-functional collaboration

Prepare and process invoices in line with PO terms and coordinate with various teams. Update and revise project budgets based on approved change orders. Funding revaluation and accommodating currency fluctuations and reflecting in the project cost Execute and track internal project cost transfers to ensure correct allocation of project expenses. For the monthly invoiced projects, revenue events creation. Closure of the projects in Oracle and clarity as per PM and PA team Prepare and update EAC reports to support financial plan tracking. Create and manage task codes and Oracle related tasks to support team. Allocate and adjust project resources in Clarity, including timesheet adjustments and alignment with project requirements. Create projects in RST (Resource Scheduling Tool), review RFR (Request for Resource), communicate with Resource Managers for resource allocations etc. Contracts Administration particularly during beginning and ending of a Project cycle. Who You Are: You display a can-do attitude in good and bad times. You recognize when a solution can be balanced. You focus and monitor both formal and informal progress regularly. You provide calmness and efficiency, even when things are unclear. You convert ideas into actions and produce results with new initiatives. Candidate must exhibit confidentiality, truthfulness & accuracy of data in reporting. Self-Motivation and ready to accept challenging assignments Having fast and agile decision-making approach Knows importance of keeping deadlines Proficient language and communication skills; both verbal and written Ability to write reports, business correspondence and other applicable documents. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.

job.title: Project Controls Specialist IV
job.sourceDescription:
At Fluor, we are proud to design and build projects and careers. We are committed to fostering a welcoming and collaborative work environment that encourages big-picture thinking, brings out the best in our employees, and helps us develop innovative solutions that contribute to building a better world together. If this sounds like a culture you would like to work in, you’re invited to apply for this role.

Job Description

This position performs Project Control activities and/or supervises the preparation of Project Controls activities for a project or assignment.  This role serves as Control Team Leader on small projects and provides direct supervision to a small team of Project Controls personnel, or as a Subject Manager Expert (SME) for the entire Project Controls Team in the Regional Office.

• Develop Work Breakdown and Project Coding Structures for control and integrity of work defined by the contract

• Develop totally integrated engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) schedules or cost control programs

• Recommend solutions or recovery plans to schedule or cost impact or delays

• As a Lead Scheduler analyze schedule, review delays, propose schedule recovery alternatives and presents them to internal groups as well as the client

• As Lead Cost Specialist maintain the cost system and provide required reports

• Analyze variances in cost and schedule performance against the plan, and communicate the reasons for the issuance of variance and proposed mitigation plans to Project Management

• Other duties as assigned

Basic Job Requirements

• Accredited four (4) year degree or global equivalent in applicable field of study and ten (10) years of work-related experience or a combination of education and directly related experience equal to fourteen (14) years if non-degreed; some locations may have additional or different qualifications in order to comply with local requirements  

• Ability to communicate effectively with audiences that include but are not limited to management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and visitors  

• Job related technical knowledge necessary to complete the job

• Ability to learn and apply knowledge of applicable local, state/province, and federal/national statutes and guidelines  

• Ability to attend to detail and work in a time-conscious and time-effective manner   

Other Job Requirements

Preferred Qualifications

• Possess practical experience in the use of the automated cost or schedule management systems

• Must have had leadership roles as a Control Team Lead (CTL) on a small-sized project or cost or scheduling lead on a large project

• May need  to travel internationally for project assignments and in support of business related matters  

To be Considered Candidates:
Must be authorized to work in the country where the position is located.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified individuals will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other criteria protected by governing law.
